mapper.sql: n.id AS notificationId, n.recipient_user_id AS recipientUserId, n.actor_user_id AS actorUserId, COALESCE(actor.display_name, actor.username) AS actorDisplayName, n.notification_type AS notificationType, n.resource_type AS resourceType, n.resource_id AS resourceId, n.title, n.content, n.is_read AS isRead, n.read_at AS readAt, n.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT id, recipient_user_id, actor_user_id, notification_type, resource_type, resource_id, title, content, dedup_key, is_read, read_at, created_at FROM notification WHERE dedup_key = #{dedupKey} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND is_read = 0
